scope: User-requested long playback retests at 1 and 0.5 GiB using TTS_MLX_CACHE_LIMIT. Pure MLX, Base-8bit, Fairy, seed534, tempo1.15; no inference algorithm change.

protocol.input: Original story repeated twice, 4486 graphemes, delivered at 20 graphemes/s in 2-grapheme chunks.
protocol.limitations: Two serial desktop runs, not a randomized equivalence experiment. Thermal state is not frequency. CPU snapshots are point observations. Process peak is the observed kernel high-water mark and may miss exit-time increases. Earlier runs used a different addon build; preserve their source/hash/environment records.

validation.cliAndBenchmarkCompilation: Direct tsc -p for CLI and benchmark succeeded; dependency build tsc -b packages/cli hit unrelated existing packages/agent pi-ai type conflicts.
validation.independentCodeReview: Review and confirm review passed before measurements.

shortPairs.validation: 12 unique PIDs, exit0/EOS, same addon/config/reference/PCM hashes and sample counts. Both conditions use the new TTS environment variable; the global override is unset.
shortPairs.limitations: Small serial adjacent pairs, after sustained playback. Alternating order reduces simple order bias but does not remove nonlinear thermal, carry-over or desktop load. Exploratory log-t interval is not proof of equivalence.
